description: The shared base of a text input (text field, text area, search field): it reads `isDisabled` as the `disabled` facet and whether `value` holds text as the `hasValue` facet (`false` while it is unset, null or empty). `clear` empties `value` and emits `change`, only while there is a value; `submit` emits `submit` and changes nothing. Both are ignored while the input is disabled. Typing, selection, IME and autocomplete are not modeled. The extending contract lists `isDisabled` and `value` in its `state`.
